short.en_US: Heroes get 14 more artifact slots: 7 misc (12 in all), 4 rings, a second armour, weapon and necklace slot - each can be switched off. Artifacts in the new slots work exactly like in a normal slot (stats, abilities, Emerald/TUM/ACM equip effects, spells, combinations). Hero, meeting, merchant and altar screens, with or without Legend Heroes.
